clips.title: The story
paras: In Auberdine, Barithras Moonshade looks to the wilds of Darkshore for rare subterranean plants. The night elf seeks travelers willing to explore the shadowy land and gather them.

Barithras Moonshade watches over Auberdine and helps the night elves study and manage Darkshore. He sends travelers into nearby caverns to gather fungi, including death cap mushrooms, for study and use.
Barithras also guides capable travelers south to meet Onu. The ancient works to heal Darkshore's tainted soil and soothe its restless natural spirits.
